We’re seeing an increase in FSD-subscribed legacy Model S and X receiving the latest production build 2026.32.3, which does not contain V14 Lite.

This update also makes these vehicles ineligible to receive V14 Lite at this time.


Anthony Spina (@Speenuh)

Safe to say 14.2 lite isn’t going to legacy S/X @teslascope 😕





— http://nitter.jaydenha.uk/Speenuh/status/2099713134797734267#m

Our take: It’s been months since V14 Lite was first released and we’ve seen zero inclusion of legacy vehicles and no communication about expected timelines.

Given this update, we anticipate there’s more of a wait to be expected now before legacy sees their first V14 Lite build.

2026.32.3 includes security improvements, which are typically recommended to be installed as soon as possible.

While we understand the concerns about legacy vehicles becoming ineligible to receive V14 Lite (without a future unreleased release), we still encourage all to update.
